offensiveAbilities.name: Compression
offensiveAbilities.description: A giant octopus can move through a gap at least 2 feet wide without Squeezing, and can Squeeze through a gap at least 1 foot wide.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(1d8+9) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Giant Octopus Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 2 2d6 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 1, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 2, and off-guard (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Ink Cloud
offensiveAbilities.description:
The octopus emits a cloud of black ink in a 30ft Emanation. This cloud has no effect outside of water. Creatures inside the cloud are Undetected and can't use their sense of smell. The cloud dissipates after 1 minute.

The octopus can't use Ink Cloud again for 2d6 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Jet
offensiveAbilities.description: The octopus moves up to 200 feet in a straight line through the water without triggering reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Writhing Arms
offensiveAbilities.description:
The giant octopus makes up to four Strikes with different arms, each against a different target. Each attack counts separately for the octopus's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase the until the octopus has made all the attacks.

If the octopus subsequently uses the Grab action, it can Grab any number of creatures it hit with Writhing Arms.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
